reader.requirement: At --std 85 CURRENCY SIGN IS literal-6 must be refused when literal-6 is any 1985 figurative constant (ZERO/ZEROS/ZEROES, SPACE/SPACES, HIGH-VALUE(S), LOW-VALUE(S), QUOTE(S), ALL literal, a symbolic-character), and a nonnumeric one-character literal must be accepted as the currency symbol.

edition-consulted.switches: hexadecimal literal-8 refusal only from 2014 (Edition.DialectLevel >= 2014); the figurative-constant test itself is edition-blind
hexadecimal bare literal-7 needs PICTURE SYMBOL from 2014; the WITH PICTURE SYMBOL phrase is gated as currency-picture-symbol-2002 (COBOL0893 at 85)

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for the figurative-constant refusal; the 1985 format has no PICTURE SYMBOL phrase and no hexadecimal literal, both refused at 85 by their gates
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb791 covers SPACE only; ZERO, QUOTE, HIGH-VALUE, LOW-VALUE, their plurals, ALL literal and a symbolic-character are not exercised

probes.printed: EXIT 65; COBOL0892 CURRENCY SIGN SPACE: literal-7 shall be ... not a figurative constant (same for SPACES, ZERO, ZEROS, ZEROES, QUOTE, QUOTES, HIGH-VALUE, HIGH-VALUES, LOW-VALUE, LOW-VALUES)
EXIT 65; COBOL0892 CURRENCY SIGN ALL "#": ... this is a figurative constant
probes.expected: refused: ALL literal is a figurative constant

probes.printed: EXIT 65; COBOL0892 CURRENCY SIGN HASHCH: literal-7 is a literal, and 'HASHCH' names no constant entry
probes.expected: refused: a symbolic-character is a figurative constant

probes.printed: EXIT 65; COBOL0893 CURRENCY SIGN WITH PICTURE SYMBOL requires COBOL-2002
EXIT 65; COBOL0900 hexadecimal alphanumeric literal requires COBOL-2002

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.4.5.3 SR12  (4.5.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR12

reader.notes: CurrencyOperandOf classifies the written operand and refuses every figurative-constant form with COBOL0892 at every edition; a symbolic-character is refused through the constant-name path with a message that speaks of constant entries (a 2002 notion), which is a diagnosis-wording issue, not a conformance failure. Diagnostics cite §2023 SR18 at --std 85.

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85 (refute-1985-049/src/r5-*.cob) on forms the reader did not try: lowercase 'currency sign is space' -> COBOL0892; CURRENCY ZERO (SIGN and IS omitted) -> COBOL0892; ALL SPACE, ALL QUOTE (ALL with a figurative), ALL "##" (multi-character ALL literal) -> COBOL0892 'this is a figurative constant'; HIGH-VALUES -> COBOL0892; a symbolic-character declared in the same paragraph (SYMBOLIC CHARACTERS HASHCH IS 36 then CURRENCY SIGN IS HASHCH) -> COBOL0892 (refused through the constant-name path; correct outcome, the wording speaks of constant entries, a later-edition notion); the legal CURRENCY SIGN IS "#" -> EXIT 0 RAN. Every 1985 figurative constant form (VI-? figurative constants: ZERO/ZEROS/ZEROES, SPACE/SPACES, HIGH-VALUE(S), LOW-VALUE(S), QUOTE(S), ALL literal, symbolic-character) is refused between the reader's probes and these.
